title: Byte-packed C++ per-view constants put ViewInfo at 308 while the shader's ViewData block starts it on the next 16-byte register (320)
expected_finding: in ViewData, ScaledTimeParam opens a new 16-byte slot at 304 and the float4 ViewInfo is placed at 320; the packed host struct MaterialShaderDataPerView has ScaledTimeParam at 304 and ViewInfo at 308, so ViewInfo, ScreenSize, TemporalAAJitter, LargeWorldsChunkIndex and LargeWorldsChunkSize are all read 12 bytes off
